verification.transport: official OpenCode V2 client -> localhost official server -> inference endpoint

known_limits: Free availability is described by OpenCode as limited-time; it can disappear without notice.
Provider rate limits and account limits still apply and are not bypassed.
The model is accessed only for proposal text; it has no tool authority.
selection_reason: Verified working under V2 on this device, zero input/output price, 200k context, tool use and reasoning metadata, and explicit coding-model tier. Big Pickle and other free candidates were considered but not benchmarked; this model had direct evidence of successful execution here.
